related.title: Lamport clock：因果順序與不可逆推論
related.titleEn: Lamport clocks: causality and the invalid converse
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：建立 bit array 與固定雜湊位置，測試不存在 key 的誤判及已插入 key 的保證。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a bit array with fixed hash positions and test false positives while retaining inserted-key membership. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 依傳送、接收與本地事件重算邏輯時鐘，分清時間戳較小與因果較早。
related.differenceEn: Recompute logical clocks for sends,receives and local events,and distinguish timestamp order from causality.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 標準只增不刪 Bloom filter 可有假陽性，不能有假陰性；誤判公式假設近似獨立均勻雜湊。 教學基準：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability；第二檢核：1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
事件前先遞增；接收用 max(local,received)+1。a→b 推得 C(a)<C(b)，反向推論不成立。 教學基準：max(3,2)+1 = 4 Q receive clock；第二檢核：4+1 = 5 Q next local clock。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A standard insert-only Bloom filter allows false positives but no false negatives; rate formulas assume approximately uniform independent hashes. Teaching baseline: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability; second check: 1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Increment for events; receive uses max(local,received)+1. Happens-before implies timestamp order,not conversely. Teaching baseline: max(3,2)+1 = 4 Q receive clock; second check: 4+1 = 5 Q next local clock. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Chandy–Lamport：分散式 snapshot 與在途訊息
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：建立 bit array 與固定雜湊位置，測試不存在 key 的誤判及已插入 key 的保證。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a bit array with fixed hash positions and test false positives while retaining inserted-key membership. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 建立兩程序轉帳事件，保存局部狀態之外還需記錄在途訊息。
related.differenceEn: Build a two-process transfer trace showing why snapshots need in-flight messages as well as local state.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

分散式一致切面不能包含 receive 卻缺少 send；模型假設可靠 FIFO channel，marker 切出 channel state。 教學基準：7+5 = 12 local-only snapshot tokens；第二檢核：7+5+3 = 15 snapshot with channel tokens。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A standard insert-only Bloom filter allows false positives but no false negatives; rate formulas assume approximately uniform independent hashes. Teaching baseline: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability; second check: 1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A consistent cut cannot include a receive without its send; the model assumes reliable FIFO channels and markers delimit channel state. Teaching baseline: 7+5 = 12 local-only snapshot tokens; second check: 7+5+3 = 15 snapshot with channel tokens. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
